class.name: HTMLAnchorElement
class.brief_description: A handle to an HTML anchor element.
class.description: Returned by queries and [method HTMLLayout.create_element] for [code]<a>[/code]. Use [method HTMLLabel.activate_element] to activate a link from script.

method.name: get_resolved_href
method.description: Returns the link address resolved against the current document base. Activating a link still reports the original [member href].

members.member: The original [code]href[/code] attribute. An empty or missing value cannot be activated.
The descendant text content. Assigning a value replaces the children with plain text.
